mapRecords.note: Thank you for playing "Wrath of the Mind Lords", the third and final chapter of the Sword Lands Trilogy! Other installments of the trilogy include: "Trouble in the Sword Lands" (Part 1) and "War in the Sword Lands" (Part 2).

Location of the house of the late witch Librunae. Librunae gave her life 10 years ago while fighting the great black dragon called Black Kiss. The X indicates where a memorial cairn was erected amidst the ruins of her house.

Map of the North-Western Khanark Rockies. Noble: Ylsasnorh (lankharhans); Tent: New Canaan; Bracers: Imperial slave mines; "X": Cave of wailing winds; Portals: approximate locations of known passages under the mountains.
Location of the house of Selina Vack in Ylsasnorh.
Location of the place in the Forest of Aurystan (in the year 529 R.R.) where Kith Khanaan hid the imprisoned essences of four evil Mentarchs, thousands of years earlier.
Map found on a table in the cellar of the Sleepless Dragon.
Map found on a table in the maurauders' hideout.
Map found on a table in the bandits' hideout.
Map indicating the location of the crypt of the old Nuramin Dynasty.
Map indicating the location of the crypt of the Tarturian Dynasty.
Map indicating the location of the crypt of the old Narosian Dynasty.
Map indicating the location of a castle in the Western Province where Ayed's employers await for your arrival, in order to offer you a well-paying job.
Map indicating the location near Tanirith of a place to meet with a liaison working for the apparent true leaders of the brigands.

The Scales Swamps. Legend: old temple, tellurian ruins; lizard man, lizard man community; troll, area concentrated in trolls; crocodile, area concentrated in crocs. The "X" indicates where the Scales River enters into the Forgotten Valley.

The greater Seacrest area on the Azure Coast. Legend: green noble, Seacrest; commoner, Edgemoor; elf, Lorill; tree, Spring Dale; blue noble, Calember; gnome, Goldylock; foodstuffs, Wavyn. The "X" mark places of interest.

Map of a south-western part of the Forgotten Valley. Legend: snake, Ssethanti community; ssethanti priest, Ziggurat sacred to the Ssethanti. The "X" marks the location of very ancient doors set into the mountain wall.
Location of the lair of the dragon Death Emerald, in Mount Fangs, somewhere in the southeast region of the Forgotten Valley.
Area of the northern region of the Forgotten Valley. Legend: cathoon, cathoon community; human, Mayaltec community. The "X" marks the location of an old monolith.
Location of the final resting place of the lich Aztranak, in the Scales Swamps.

The following is scribbled on the back of this map: "Make sure to have destroyed their portraits after memorizing them. To receive payment for the deed, bring the head of anyone of them. The password is: mindbender."
